$comment: COREDEV-2801 §3b — the SessionStart surface of the plugin-version drift detector.
This is the surface that fires WHEN THE STALE CODE BEGINS RUNNING, which is the defect as it was
actually reported: a session bound to a version no source serves. The pre-commit surface catches
the other case, where hooks are disabled in the session but not in git.
MATCHERS ARE startup AND resume ONLY. SessionStart also fires on `clear` and `compact`, and a
warning at those moments is noise about a condition the human already saw at startup.
TIMEOUT 5, AS A LITERAL. The key alone would accept the 600-second default this contract exists to
override; the detector does two small JSON reads and one `git show`, so anything slower is broken
and failing fast is the right answer.
THE REPOSITORY ROOT IS PASSED EXPLICITLY. The detector never reads CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR itself —
git does not set it for the other caller, and a value inherited from a different project would
silently compare against a foreign manifest.
